contract.name: capacity-buffer-strategy
contract.workload: 12 fixed development pressure scenarios and 12 disjoint holdout scenarios with per-scenario raw records
contract.resource_envelope: one serial Python process, 30 second evaluator timeout
contract.budget_and_stop_rule: two generations, three candidates per generation, stop on budget or no improvement

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: reduce excess reserve and right-size the batch
repair service while minimizing committed capacity
deterministic_plan.mechanism: minimum feasible reserve with smaller batch
exact duplicate used to verify source deduplication

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: move batch to the analytic cost minimum
deterministic_plan.mechanism: minimum feasible reserve with cost-optimal batch

deterministic_plan.hypothesis: repair the infeasible line while preserving a small batch
deterministic_plan.mechanism: minimum feasible reserve with intermediate batch

budget.wall_time_scope: generation, dev evaluation, freeze, and holdout after one-time baseline initialization
